question: Who was the captain of Indian cricket team when India won the Cricket World Cup in 1983?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Kapil Dev.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As reffered ahead, India played under the captaincy of **Kapil Dev** in the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• Dev was be one of **best all-rounders of that era,** and he played** 225 ODI** matches in his career.
 
• He picked up** 253 wickets and scored 3,783 runs.**
 
• **Kapil Dev**-led India win maiden World Cup trophy in 1983.

• **Mohinder Amarnath Bhardwaj** is an Indian former cricketer,current cricket analyst and actor.​ 
 
• Sunil Manohar Gavaskar is an **Indian cricket commentator and former cricketer who represented India and Bombay from 1971 to 1987**.
 
• Ravishankar Jayadritha Shastri is the **former cheif coach of the India national cricket team, a cricket commentator and former captain of Indian Cricket Team**.
